messages:
Anya: Quick customer ask — NovusHealth needs a pack for the POC: SOC2 excerpt, ISO artifact, control mapping, and a pen-test attestation. Demo Monday. Can we get a redacted bundle we can send today?

Ravi: I can assemble the bundle. Do we have a standard pen-test attestation template? @Priya any guardrails on redacting pen-test output?

Priya: We can provide a redacted attestation + SOC2 summary. Don't include raw vuln details. Legal must sign the pen-test letter (we can't send an unsigned internal report). Also confirm: only staging creds/ips, not prod.

Josh: FYI if they want dedicated staging for residency the pricing changes. If this is hosted for the POC, clarify expected QPS so we can avoid surprise pricing asks.

Anya: For the POC they said ~10 rps peak, small data set. Initially they prefer hosted but want EU data residency mention. Can we send hosted SOC2 artifacts + a draft pen-test attestation that legal can sign?

Ravi: Will prep: SOC2 summary, control matrix excerpt, ISO scope doc, network diagram, and pen-test attestation template. I'll redact vuln specifics and link a draft.

Priya: Use the legal pen-test template (internal path). Redact CVE identifiers and exploit traces. Add a one-paragraph EU residency statement about region and keys. I'll eyeball it before send.

Ravi: Uploading draft bundle now: https://drive.redwood.com/s/novus-poc-draft (draft includes redacted vuln list placeholder). Please review.

Marta: I can sign the attestation once redacted. Need the customer legal name and point-of-contact for the signature block. Also prefer the attestation to state: "redacted for security" rather than listing specific removals.

Anya: Customer legal name: NovusHealth Inc. POC: Claire Dunn <claire@novus.com>. I'll DM the contract contact and any NDA status.

Ravi: Updated draft with Claire contact and EU residency paragraph. Changed vuln section to: "vulnerabilities redacted for customer safety; full report available under NDA."

Priya: That language works. I approved redactions. Also add a short note about KMS/HSM availability and support for on-prem.

Josh: If they pivot to dedicated for residency during POC, ping me — I'll pull a quick committed-rate estimate for single-tenant staging.

Marta: Received draft, signing when Anya confirms Claire + any NDA link.

Anya: Confirmed — NDA is in place, sending Marta NDA link now. Will send the bundle to Claire after Marta signs. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Ravi: Final draft uploaded and shared with Marta. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/s/novus-poc-final

Priya: Approved.

Marta: Signed and returned the attestation. Anya — you can send.

Anya: Sent to Claire with a short cover note and follow-up slot for Monday demo. Closing loop here. :tada:
